acts.d: OceanLotus uses a targeted phishing attack with an attachment.
Hope Potter downloads a macOS application disguised Word document.
This document, conkylan.app, now resides in the /Downloads folder on Hope Potter's macOS Catalina Host.
The Word document is actually an Application bundle, the the first stage payload.
The second stage of the payload detonates and deploys a decoy Word document, and connects to the C2 server.
Using the script, OceanLotus also installs persistence via Launch Agent
OceanLotus then removes file information used by security tools
OceanLotus conducts local system discovery on the macOS host.
OceanLotus reviews the contents of the .ssh folder. Seeing there is an SSH key, the known_hosts and history files are exfiled to the C2 server for analysis.
The history file reveals Hope Potter sends files to the file server using SCP
OceanLotus downloads Rota Jakiro to the macOS host in the /Users/hpotter/Library/WebKit folder (the execution folder for OSX.OceanLotus) as osx.download
OSX.OceanLotus then uses SCP to transfer Rota Jakiro to the \tmp folder of the Linux host
Using SSH, OSX.OceanLotus changes Rota Jakiro to an executable
OceanLotus executes Rota Jakiro on the Linux host
For initial collection, Rota Jakiro executes and collects the results from the uname syscall.

Rota Jakiro sends the following information regarding the Linux host to the C2 server: Host name, Architecture, & Kernel version. Rota Jakiro then downloads and executes a shared object (mount.so file) performing discovery for mounted drives connected to the Linux host.
The resulting information is saved to the mount.txt file. Rota Jakiro then uploads this file to the C2 server for offline analysis
OceanLotus downloads and executes a shared object on the Linux host (pdf.so). The shared object performs the following actions:
1. Creates a hidden directory named tmp.rota folder
All files are then compressed into a single file named rota.tar.gz
2. Starting from the $HOME folder using the find command, copy files with a .pdf extension into the tmp.rota folder
OceanLotus tasks Rota Jakiro to upload the /tmp/rota.tar.gz file to the C2 server completeing the objective.
